caption: The drawing shows a garment resembling a short cape or cloak, with the central focus on a detailed front view and a less detailed outline of the back view in the upper right. The main cape is colored in deep green with subtle shading that gives a sense of fabric texture and volume, and features decorative trim or detailing along the collar, edges, and arm openings. The interior of the arm openings is rendered in shades of yellow and light brown, suggesting a lining or alternative fabric color inside the garment. The collar stands upright and is also decorated with the same trimmed pattern. The composition places the colored cape centrally and prominently, while the back view in the upper right corner is simply outlined in pencil and decorated at the hem with a similarly patterned trim, lacking any green or yellow coloring. The background is an off-white or cream color, and no additional objects or scenery are present.
title: Dolman
